verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a developer platform with a CLI, Copilot, and IDE integrations, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The only nearby item (github-docs-53) says Copilot settings can be configured, but it never mentions telemetry, data collection, or tracking controls, so it cannot be credited.
